# Agentic Serving and State Reuse {#sec-agentic-serving}

::: {.callout-note title="Outline scaffold"}

This page makes the agreed chapter architecture renderable in Quarto. It records the chapter question, planned coverage, and intended systems outcome; full manuscript prose, figures, worked examples, fallacies, and exercises remain to be developed.

:::

## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_How does serving change when requests become related steps with reusable state and irregular timing?_

## Planned Coverage

- Prefill, decode, tool-wait, and resume phases
- Session affinity and disaggregated state
- Prefix, result, and trajectory-state reuse
- Cache validity, privacy, and authorization keys
- Tail latency under branching and bursty resumptions

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to design a serving path that exploits safe reuse while preserving isolation and latency objectives.
